full_prompt_en: A square painterly image shows a young woman in a quiet three-quarter profile, surrounded so closely by blossoms that the foliage reaches every edge of the frame. Behind her, dark green leaves and deep brown shadow hold clusters of pale cream, warm white, and dusty pink flowers. Across the upper edge, layered petals and pointed leaves form an irregular canopy. In the middle of the image, her dark brown hair is gathered loosely at the back of her head, with soft bangs curving over her forehead and a few strands crossing the temple. Her face turns toward the right and tilts downward, so the closed or lowered eye, straight nose, flushed cheek, and gently closed lips are seen in profile. The warm pink of her cheek is the strongest small color accent among the pale blooms. At the left edge, a dense white flower head presses toward her hair; another pink cluster overlaps the space behind her cheek on the right. Below her chin, a cream blouse with a pointed collar and softly pleated front fills the lower center. Its off-white fabric is partly hidden by flowers in the foreground, and the neckline sinks into the surrounding shadow. Along the lower left, coral-pink petals and dark stems rise in front of the garment. At the lower right, several white ruffled blooms overlap one another, while a warmer pink bloom is clipped by the border. The flowers are painted as thick layered masses rather than separated botanical specimens: some petals are sharply defined where light touches them, while others soften into their neighbors. The image has visible, slightly broken painterly texture over the skin, hair, fabric, and vegetation, with selective fine accents at the eyelashes, lips, and petal rims. Light appears to fall gently from the upper left, illuminating the woman's cheek and the nearest pale blossoms while leaving the foliage almost black. The soft shadows under the hair and chin give the head a delicate rounded volume without isolating it from the floral field. The overall composition is close, still, and densely framed, balancing creamy whites and muted coral pink against dark green-brown recesses.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画感图像呈现一位安静地侧转的年轻女子，繁花紧贴着她，枝叶延伸至画面每条边缘。她身后，深绿叶片与深褐阴影托住淡奶油色、暖白色和灰粉色的成簇花朵。上边缘处，层叠花瓣与尖叶形成不规则的花冠。画面中央，她深褐色头发松松地挽在脑后，柔软的刘海弯过额头，几缕发丝经过太阳穴。她的脸朝右并向下倾，侧面可见低垂或闭合的眼睛、挺直的鼻子、泛红的面颊和轻轻合拢的嘴唇。脸颊的暖粉色是浅色花朵之间最醒目的小面积色彩重音。左边缘，一簇浓密白花靠近她的头发；右侧另一簇粉花重叠在脸颊后方的空间。下巴以下，带尖领和柔软褶裥前襟的奶油色上衣占据下方中央。灰白布料部分被前景的花遮住，领口沉入周围阴影。左下方，珊瑚粉花瓣与深色花茎升到衣服前面。右下方，几簇白色皱瓣花互相重叠，一朵较暖的粉花则被边缘截断。花朵被画成厚实的层叠色团，而非彼此分开的植物标本：部分花瓣在受光处边缘清晰，其余则柔化并融入邻近花朵。皮肤、头发、布料与植物表面都可见略微破碎的绘画肌理，睫毛、嘴唇和花瓣边缘则有选择性细节。光似乎从左上方柔和落下，照亮女子的面颊与最近的浅色花朵，使叶丛几乎陷入黑色。头发和下巴下方的柔影赋予头部细腻的圆润体积，又不将其从花团中孤立出来。整体构图亲近、静止而密集，以奶油白与暗珊瑚粉平衡深绿褐色的空隙。
style_prompt_en: The painterly image uses dense organic layering, with pale shapes emerging from a dark green-brown ground. Creamy whites and muted blush or coral tones appear in clustered patches, while small warm highlights draw attention to selected edges. Forms remain softly modeled rather than outlined throughout; crisp details are reserved for a few focal contours, and neighboring shapes often merge through broken brush texture. Gentle directional light brings forward the nearest planes and allows deeper layers to recede almost into black. The surface carries fine grain and visible painterly variation, so smooth passages sit beside rougher, petal-like strokes. Overlapping masses fill the frame to its edges, creating an intimate, enveloping rhythm with very little empty space. The overall effect is romantic and hushed, with delicate light held inside lush, shadowed color.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画感图像采用密集的有机层叠，让浅色形体从深绿褐色底面浮现。奶油白、低饱和腮红粉与珊瑚色成簇分布，少量暖亮点将视线引向选定的边缘。形体以柔和塑形呈现，不全程依靠轮廓线；清晰细节只留给少数焦点边界，相邻形状常通过破碎笔触相互融合。柔和的定向光将最近的平面推向前方，使更深的层次几乎退入黑暗。表面带有细微颗粒与可见的绘画变化，平滑区域和较粗碎、近似花瓣的笔触相邻。重叠的色团充满画框直至边缘，以极少留白形成亲密而包围式的节奏。整体效果浪漫且静谧，细腻的光被保存在丰茂而幽暗的色彩内部。
theme_en: A dark-haired young woman in profile among pale pink and white blossoms
theme_zh: 淡粉与白色繁花间侧脸低垂的深发年轻女子
name: Meghan Howland
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
